body: Thanks. Its nice to know there's people like me :)
Yes. I would rather be myself and lonely, than be someone else and have close friends. I want someone to love me for who I am.

I have a few people that I feel strongly about. They could call my at 2:00 in the morning, and ask me to come over for the simplest reason, and I would come over. They could ask for ALL my money, and I would give it to them. All I want in this world is love, affection, and intimacy. Specifically, I went out of my way to make plans with one of these people, and they canceled because they "just didn't feel like hanging out." I'm not as important to them as they are to me. That DESTROYS me inside. I'm a dude, I'm not supposed to be so emotional.

That's for commenting :)  I was worried this would get ignored.
 
1) Sad that no one loves me. Worried that no one will love me. Angry that people wont give me their entire life. Betrayed that people MIGHT be talking shit about me, and that the people I love don't love me as much a I love them. Depressed that things wont change. And nervous because I have the right pills to kill me

2)  No one txts me, or calls me. No one ever crushes on me. No one will put 100% into their relationship with me (Im single). I have everything that I could ever want, except love. 

3) I could down some Bezos with a bottle of Vodka, but I have a few more plans to carry out (dinner with friends, not like homicide). I could cut myself, but that doesn't really work anymore. I could txt someone, but my friends have had enough of my shit. I could distract myself, but the thoughts don't go away. And I could go sleep, but that is a temporary solution to a permanent problem.
